changelog: Simpler settings: choose a clip from /intros and switch intros on for movies and/or series episodes. The clip list is read from disk and unscanned files trigger a scan of the intro library; Rescan button. The intro library may hold several clips and is still hidden. Allow-lists and episode modes were removed.
description: Plays an intro clip from /intros before movies and/or series episodes using Jellyfin's cinema-mode intro mechanism. Pick the clip from a dropdown, rescan the intro folder from the settings page, and keep the intro library hidden from every user's home screen.
name: Movie Intro
overview: Intro before movies and series episodes (cinema mode)
